summary: Undated 1930s lookout in Fremont National Forest, Lake County, Oregon; listed as gone, with no site or removal details in the sources read.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. firelookout.com gives only a 1930s date and no site or removal details.

evidence.supports: date line reads 1930s: unknown, no year given; listed as gone
stood in the Fremont National Forest
Oregon list marks it gone, type unknown
lookout is in Lake County, Oregon

notes_for_editor: Two thin sources, both listing the lookout as gone. The '1930s: unknown' line is ambiguous and is quoted as written. The site description ('18 miles NNW of Bly') does not match the record coordinates closely: from the FFLA coordinates the site is about 14 miles from the Bly Ranger Station, though the page may measure from the town. The story now attributes the 18 miles to firelookout.com rather than stating it as fact. The firelookout.com page has a 'Click for larger image' link, but no photo URL was found in the text read. The forest name is as the page gives it; the record has no agency and none was added.
